\section*{Supplementary data}

The Supplementary Information contains the supplementary notes, tables and figure cited in the text, and the data files with a column dictionary.


\section*{Data and code availability}

The search configurations and exports, screening and charting outputs, the operation library (version 1.3.0), the analysis code and the source data of every figure panel are available at https://github.com/BogdanDidenko/text-bio-fundational-models-review (this version: commit bae00337). \nolinkurl{manuscript/supplementary/README.md} gives the repository path of every supplementary item, and the earlier version of this manuscript, with its internal labels, is \nolinkurl{manuscript/archive/review_manuscript_draft_v0.5.1.md} (commit 4c4db9f0). The component library is browsable at https://bogdandidenko.github.io/text-bio-fundational-models-review/component-library/. The review materials of this version are deposited on Zenodo (https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23437391): the screening prompts and the output of every screening agent for every record, the outputs of the agents that extracted information from the included papers, the operation library and the Supplementary Information with its data files. The protocol with its amendments is a separate record (https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23437389). Both DOIs are reserved and become active when the records are published. The texts of the papers and the run logs of the LLM agents, which embed them, are not deposited; the deposit keeps the responses of the agents without the prompts, and the prompts of the screening roles are reproduced in Supplementary Note S3.
